pilot_runtime: Codex subagents; not evidence of the external API response model ID
notes: The completed pilot is not the preregistered full API matrix and must not be labeled as a GPT-5.6 API benchmark.
OPTIMUS and Chain-of-Experts pilot artifacts are inspired compatibility adapters, not unmodified upstream package runs.
API credentials are supplied only through environment variables and are never committed.
The corpus-search track may retrieve only from the frozen 400-document evidence corpus.
The no-search track receives no evidence corpus, browser, network, or search result.
The oracle-evidence track receives the applicable evidence text and isolates formulation ability from retrieval.
